items.title: Mike Davis interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2024
items.q: the two soloists on that were Troy Roberts on tenor saxophone and Mike Rodriguez... And all three of their solos it was just like what do you want?

ctx.x: It just sounded fantastic. The recording quality and the playing, the whole package. Do you recall how many takes that one took?

I do actually. Thank you for mentioning that track. I’m super fond of it and it was actually a composition/arrangement by my son, Cole Davis, who is an outstanding bass player and writer as well. And that was three takes. We did three takes on that. And all three of them were usable. In fact sometimes we’ll use a little bit — oh you know what? I like this solo from that take so let’s like move — you know you can, the technology is at such a high level nowadays, there’s a lot of — you know editing is the best word…
Yeah your drummer had a — he has a great expression on his face when he gets through it.
